learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge of the role of industrial PLCs in the automation and robotics systems. Ability to write and test control programs.
Knows of the principles of configuration and programming of industrial PLC controllers.
Can program and tests mechatronic systems with PLC controllers for various physical processes.
Is ready to supplement and critically evaluate specialist knowledge and is able to select appropriate sources of knowledge and learning methods.

syllabus_topics: Manufacturers and families of industrial controllers.
Elements of visualization of the control process.
Supervision and data acquisition systems SCADA (4h).
Programming and commissioning of PLC controllers with models of electropneumatic and drive systems (10h).
Tests PLC programs in the simulator environment (5h).
teaching_methods: practical methods (demonstration, laboratory exercises, project method, simulation)

assessment_methods.method: Positive grades from entrance cards and reports for laboratory

assessment_rules: The condition for passing the course is to achieve all required learning outcomes. Lectures are passed based on a written test. Completion of the laboratory requires the performance of exercises and obtaining positive grades from entrance cards and reports. The method of calculating the final grade for the course is specified in the regulations.
